injuries.name: Teoscar Hernandez
injuries.note: 10-Day-IL: Hernandez (hamstring) is expected to report to Triple-A Oklahoma City to begin a rehab assignment this week in hopes of coming off the injured list for the Doders' series opener against the Athletics on June 29, Sonja Chen of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: 60-Day-IL: The Royals transferred Ragans (elbow) to the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
